paper_title: Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language   Model Training for the Sámi Language
caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens and sentences across various categories within the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis, labeled “Categories,” displays the different domains, ordered alphabetically from “Administrative” to “Blogs.” The vertical axis, titled “Sentences (K),” represents the number of sentences in thousands, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, marked by tick intervals of 200. The tallest bar, representing the “News” category, extends to approximately 760, while the shortest bar, representing the “Blogs” category, reaches a height of 2.  The other bars, representing “Science,” “Religion”, “Non-fiction”, “Fiction”, and “Law,” have approximate heights of 110, 190, 35, 525, and 800 respectively. Each bar is colored red, and the chart displays a single, unsegmented bar for each category, presenting the total number of sentences within that domain. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
